title: TCG: Paradox Rift
description: Ancient and Future Paradox Pokémon collide!

questions.question: What is the central theme of Paradox Rift?
questions.explanation: The set heavily features Ancient and Future Paradox Pokémon from Paldea's Area Zero.

questions.question: Paradox Rift introduced the Ancient and Future trait designations on cards.
questions.explanation: Cards with 'Ancient' or 'Future' subtypes had special interactions with other Paradox cards.

questions.question: Which Future Paradox Pokémon ex was a competitive standout?
questions.explanation: Iron Hands ex's Amp You Very Much attack rewarded knockouts with bonus prizes.

questions.question: Roaring Moon ex appears in Paradox Rift.
questions.explanation: Roaring Moon ex is one of the headline Ancient Paradox cards in the set.

questions.question: Which legendary Paldea cover Pokémon got an ACE SPEC equivalent ex card?
questions.explanation: Walking Wake ex appears in Paradox Rift, the Ancient Paradox of Suicune.

questions.question: Approximately how many cards are in Paradox Rift?
questions.explanation: Paradox Rift contains 266 cards including secret rares.

questions.question: Garchomp ex appears in Paradox Rift, along with Gible and Gabite.
questions.explanation: Garchomp ex is featured in the set alongside its pre-evolutions.

questions.question: Which Iron Pokémon serves as the Future counterpart to Tauros?
questions.explanation: Iron Treads is the Future Paradox form of Donphan, sometimes thought connected to Tauros by fans but officially tied to Donphan.

questions.question: Paradox Rift is the fourth main set in the Scarlet & Violet era.
questions.explanation: It follows SV base, Paldea Evolved, and Obsidian Flames as the 4th main expansion (151 was a special set).
